- z is my top preference, but I'm only 2nd priority there
- w is my 2nd preference where I have top priority
- y is my 3rd preference where I also have top priority
- x is my least preferred, where I have 2nd priority

To maximize my chances, I should rank schools to balance preference and priority:
- Put z first (my top preference)
- Put w second (high preference, high priority)
- Put y third (moderate preference, high priority)
- Put x last (lowest preference)

This strategy gives me the best chance of getting a school I like while being realistic about competition.
